Home physiotherapy

Physiotherapy at home, across Hyderabad

For patients recovering from surgery or a stroke, travelling to a clinic is often the hardest part of the treatment. Our physiotherapists come to you — with the same assessment, equipment and follow-up you would get at the hospital.

Mon–Sun, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM

How it works

  1. 1. Tell us where you are

    Enter your address and the condition you need help with.

  2. 2. Pick your physiotherapist

    Choose from our home-visit team and see their availability.

  3. 3. Book your first visit

    Pay once for the package, then schedule sessions as you go.

  4. 4. Recover at home

    The same physiotherapist sees you through the whole programme.

Session packages

Recovery takes a course of treatment, not a single visit. Packages work out cheaper per session and keep you with the same physiotherapist. Pay once, then book each session when it suits you.

Common questions

How long does a home physiotherapy session last?+

A standard session is 60 minutes, including assessment and the exercises you will continue between visits.

Which areas do you cover for home visits?+

We cover most of the city. Enter your pincode when booking and we will confirm availability in your area.
